info.description:
Trimmed from the official X API v2 OpenAPI (https://api.x.com/2/openapi.json). Keeps paths for listing a user's posts, listing conversation replies, creating replies, fetching a post, and hiding a reply. Component schemas are original definitions pruned to refs in use.

X API v2 core endpoints
info.title: X API v2 — Comments / Replies (trimmed)

put.description: Hides or unhides a reply to a conversation owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: At most one of `start_time`, `since_id` may be provided. At most one of `end_time`, `until_id` may be provided. At most one of `pagination_token`, `next_token` may be provided.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Must be within the last 7 days.

get.description: When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`. When both are provided, `since_id` must be less than `until_id`.
